guide.title: Guide
guide.description: What you can do on LearnViaNotes: read and write notes, join groups and classrooms, and verify your profile.
guide.lead: A map of LearnViaNotes as it works today.
guide.helpLead: Email us and a person will help. You can also replay the short tour of the menu, search and your account.

read.title: Read and find notes
read.lead: Public notes are organised by subject and topic. You can search them and save the ones you want to come back to.
read.p1: Subjects lists every subject. Open a topic to read the public notes and resources people have shared on it. You can read a public note without an account.
read.p2: Search finds notes, topics, people, groups and classes. Explore in the menu opens the same search.
read.p3: Bookmarks keeps notes and resources you want to come back to. Only you see that list.

write.title: Write your own notes
write.lead: Your notes start private. You choose if anyone else can read them.
write.p1: My Notes is your library. Create Note starts a blank note made of cards: text, headings, code and pictures. Quick notes is a scratchpad, and Projects keeps a brief and a small board for one piece of work.
write.p2: Upload a PDF to read it as a note, or add photos that AI can turn into a note. On a note you can also record a voice note and transcribe it afterwards.
write.p3: Share a note with named people, with an unlisted link, or publish it so anyone can find it. Readers of a public note see the published version. You can turn forks off. A fork is a private copy that still names you.
write.p4: Making a note public can require a verified account, and confirming your sign-in email comes before some sharing actions.

groups.title: Groups
groups.lead: A group is a place to study with other students.
groups.p1: Start a group or search the public ones. A public group can be found, and people can ask to join. A private group is not listed: people join with its link, and you approve them.
groups.p2: Members can post, share a note (members read the published version), ask doubts and recommend resources.

classes.title: Classrooms
classes.lead: A class is run by a teacher.
classes.p1: Join with the class code your teacher gives you. The teacher or a TA lets you in. A class can post announcements and set quizzes.
classes.p2: A verified teacher can create a class. You can apply to teach straight away; students can join once a LearnViaNotes admin verifies you.

study.title: Study tools
study.lead: Practice, a plan for an exam, and a weekly rhythm.
study.p1: Flashcards flip front and back. Review brings those cards back when it is time, and you mark how well you knew each one.
study.p2: Quizzes can come from a class or be ones you write and share with a link. Contests are a weekly set of timed questions. Your score is yours: nobody is listed.
study.p3: Add an exam and its topics. LearnViaNotes spreads revision back from the date, and Readiness shows how well you know those topics. Rhythm is a weekly habit of planned days, not a streak you lose. It also has a focus timer and a few tasks for the week.
study.p4: Ask AI answers from notes you can read and names the notes it used. On a note, AI tasks can summarise, explain, quiz or make flashcards. Results stay beside the note and do not change it. Each plan has a daily allowance. The Plans page lists what each plan includes; looking at a price does not charge you.
study.p5: The Resources catalogue lists books, courses and tools members recommend. Moderators check each one before it is public. There are no shop links or prices. Home suggests what to pick up, and learning history and achievements record longer progress.

profile.title: Profile and verification
profile.lead: Your account holds your name, study details and verification.
profile.p1: Add a department and year of study, and choose whether they show on your public profile. That profile is at your handle. You can follow people, connect with teachers, and edit a Skills tab.
profile.p2: Confirm the email you sign in with. A college or organisation email is checked with a code we send. Without one, ask a teacher who knows you to vouch for you, or send proof of study for the team to check. When college ID checks are turned on, you can send a photo of your card.
profile.p3: Until the account is verified, sharing, commenting and joining groups stay closed. Your own notes still work.
profile.p4: Notification settings choose what also reaches your email. Everything still shows in the app.
profile.p5: Accounts start at age 13. LearnViaNotes is not directed at children under 13. From 13 to 17 a parent or guardian must give verifiable consent, in line with India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, and some features stay off until 18. Someone under 13 cannot create an account. If we learn an account belongs to someone under 13, we remove it.

tour.notesBody: My Notes is where you write. Create Note starts a new one. A note stays private until you share it. Subjects, just above, is where you read public notes.
tour.searchBody: Explore searches notes, topics, people, groups and classes. The search field in the top bar opens the same search.
tour.groupsBody: Groups are for studying with other students. You can find a public group, or start one and share notes with its members.
tour.classesBody: Classrooms are where a teacher shares notes, announcements and quizzes. Join with the class code your teacher gives you.
tour.guideBody: The guide explains each part of LearnViaNotes, and you can replay this tour from that page.
tour.accountBody: Your name, study details and verification are on your account. Verifying, with a college email, a teacher, or our team, is what lets you share notes and join groups.
tour.doneBody: You can replay these steps any time from the guide.
tour.keys: Arrow keys move between steps. Escape skips.
